title: The billable invoice document carries no stamp or category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billable, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The invoice shows the line at $240.00 (2.0 h × $120.00) and its totals, with no NO CHARGE stamp and no category line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S3-N1: “If the work order is billable, the button reads "Create invoice" and everything works as today.”
  • S12-R7: “Create invoice works as today. The invoice (preview, PDF, email, portal) shows the no-charge line with its hours and parts at $0.00 and the category name as a line under the title ("Warranty"); no stamp, no badge, no "No Charge" wording elsewhere on the document. The invoice statement of the line is priced 0 and flagged no_charge with the category and the original work order, line and technician, the way a declined line's statement is priced 0 today; its items are priced 0. The statement keeps the line's hours and labour rate for the record.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
